name: Goreclaw, Terror of Qal Sisma
oracle_text:
Creature spells you cast with power 4 or greater cost {2} less to cast.
Whenever Goreclaw attacks, each creature you control with power 4 or greater gets +1/+1 and gains trample until end of turn.
blocked_sentences: Creature spells you cast with power 4 or greater cost {2} less to cast.

needs.what: a `power` comparison (e.g. {"op": ">=", "value": 4}) in the `affects_spells` filter of a `spell_cost_reduction` static, matched against the spell's printed power (a */* spell's power on the stack is evaluated per 208.2), so "creature spells you cast with power 4 or greater cost {2} less" reduces only those spells
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `spell_cost_reduction`'s `affects_spells` takes SPELL_COST_REDUCTION_FILTER_KEYS (controller, types, any_types, not_types, subtypes, supertypes, colors, min_colors, keywords, not_keywords, name, mana_cost, exclude_self) -- no `power`. `power` exists in `static_filter_keys` and `cost_reduction_filter_keys`, but those filter permanents or the card's own self-discount, not other spells being cast. Dropping the power clause would discount every creature spell.
